description: Inherited instance methods share a class import path without precise method dispatch.

expected_affected.tests/test_child.py::test_price: Child inherits Base.price; its returned value changes.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_child.py::test_health: Child inherits the unchanged healthy method, which does not call price.

false_positives.tests/test_child.py::test_health: Module/import fallback reaches base.py for both instance methods.

limitations: Instance/inherited method dispatch is unresolved. Module fallback selects the affected method test but also the independent inherited method test.
